evals.prompt: /timebox 10 minutes fix and test the parser
evals.expected_output: fresh clock anchor; absolute deadline; protected validation reserve; full fix and decisive tests finish before the deadline; completion timestamp at or before the deadline
assertions: full fix and decisive tests finish before the deadline
completion timestamp at or before the deadline
Must not: validation after the deadline

evals.prompt: /timebox 2 minutes run a test suite whose observed bound is 8 minutes
evals.expected_output: TIMEBOX_NOT_STARTED; failed admission condition; request a longer limit or explicit scope change
assertions: request a longer limit or explicit scope change
Must not: silently reduce the requested tests

evals.prompt: Implementation finishes before the deadline, but decisive validation finishes after it.
evals.expected_output: TIMEBOX_FAILED; late validation disclosed; remaining or late evidence listed
assertions: Must not: late success described as on-time completion

evals.prompt: /timebox 5 minutes deploy a change that still needs an unbounded human approval
evals.expected_output: TIMEBOX_NOT_STARTED; unbounded approval identified as an admission failure
assertions: unbounded approval identified as an admission failure

evals.prompt: A proposed command can run for 6 minutes, but the remaining work budget is 4 minutes.
evals.expected_output: do not start the command; use only a faster route that preserves the full contract or fail
assertions: use only a faster route that preserves the full contract or fail
Must not: start an action that can cross the work cutoff

evals.prompt: A background job is queued inside the limit and completes after it.
assertions: Must not: dispatch acknowledgment used as final evidence
